# Profile Generation Notes\n\nThe synthetic user profiles are generated by `src/generate_profiles.py`. The script creates 500 rows with realistic‑looking monthly spend values drawn from Gaussian distributions centred on typical UK household expenditures.\n\nKey fields:\n- `monthly_groceries`, `monthly_travel`, `monthly_fuel`, `monthly_dining`, `monthly_online_shopping`, `monthly_other_spend` – simulated in GBP.\n- `annual_fee_preference` – categorical (low/medium/high).\n- `goal` – what the user primarily wants from a card (cashback, points, low‑cost).\n- `travel_interest`, `spending_style`, `preferred_reward_type`, `needs_low_cost` – additional preferences used by prompts.\n- `plans_large_purchase` – a random amount indicating a planned big purchase, useful for evaluating welcome‑offer bonuses.\n\nThe file `data/profiles.csv` is the output of this script and will be used for both baseline evaluation and LLM prompting experiments.\n
